$comment: About page — bio, education, languages. Both languages required.
bioZh: 我是一名对绿植和自然景观充满热情的设计师, 特别擅长参数化模型设计, 对 Grasshopper 有着深入的理解和应用. 我精通 Sketchup, 并自创了一些动态组件的建模方法, 这些技术显著提高了我的工作效率和设计质量. 此外, 我熟悉 Ladybug 等节能分析软件, 让我能在设计中融入可持续发展的理念.
bioEn: I'm a designer with a long-standing interest in green plants, natural landscape, and parametric form. Grasshopper sits at the centre of my daily workflow, paired with a Sketchup practice that I've extended with custom dynamic components. Energy and daylight tools — chiefly Ladybug — let me weave sustainability into early-stage design instead of as a late-stage check.
